adaptations: Flatten imports and retain only selected definitions; use root Effect catalog 4.0.2.

scopeHashEncoding: UTF-8, destination paths sorted ascending, one line: <destinationSha256>  <destination>\n

cryptoExtraction.scope: Content v0 HKDF-SHA-256 and XChaCha20-Poly1305 only; no signer, authority, frame workflow, ledger, host, storage or HPKE
adaptations: Synchronous HKDF extract/expand using already pinned @noble/hashes 2.2.0, preserving candidate WebCrypto HKDF-SHA-256 bytes.
Opaque context-bound derived ContentKey; leaf import/export remains outside this slice.
Bound and classify AEAD inputs before copying; use host secure randomness only with a typed unavailable result.
Wipe temporary epoch/key/PRK/plaintext copies; no signing private key or runtime service.
Run ordinary try/finally cleanup before yielding Results: Effect 4.0.2 Result.gen does not close its iterator on typed failure.

sourceSpec.scope: Sections 8.4-8.5; fixed Base suite, info, canonical four-field AAD and epoch envelope bytes

hpkeExtraction.scope: Unsigned fixed epoch HPKE seal/open only; no signer, authority, full envelope workflow, install, delivery, recovery or platform store
adaptations: Retain candidate @hpke/core 1.9.0, @hpke/chacha20poly1305 1.8.0 and @hpke/common 1.10.1 closure; Effect 4.0.2 unchanged.
Revalidate caller context and lengths before copying; preserve fixed Base mode, info, AAD and plaintext/ciphertext sizes.
Require host secure randomness with no public entropy hook; wipe operation-owned IKM/plaintext on success and failure.
Borrow native device CryptoKeyPair per call; compare its public key to trusted expected recipient; no identity generation/export/storage.
Return Effect values without creating a runtime, service or background fiber; await non-cancellable native settlement and ordinary try/finally cleanup on interruption.
Legacy JSON key-envelope.ts and ledger/delivery workflows are excluded.
